kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
أتلعثم (form IIq)
# أَتَلَعْثَمُ (ʔatalaʕṯamu) /ʔa.ta.laʕ.θa.mu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of تَلَعْثَمَ (talaʕṯama)
# أَتَلَعْثَمَ (ʔatalaʕṯama) /ʔa.ta.laʕ.θa.ma/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of تَلَعْثَمَ (talaʕṯama)
# أَتَلَعْثَمْ (ʔatalaʕṯam) /ʔa.ta.laʕ.θam/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of تَلَعْثَمَ (talaʕṯama)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
